items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Tooltip on Base UI Tooltip: opens on hover and on keyboard focus, Escape dismisses (WCAG 1.4.13), popup text is the trigger's accessible description.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Square Enix or PlatinumGames. Compose Tooltip, TooltipTrigger, TooltipContent. The wrapper sets aria-describedby on the trigger while open, because Base UI does not link them. Do not put interactive content inside TooltipContent; use Popover for that.
